ZAF.note: Nothing stated on civil register and ID links.
Staff payroll is discussed but not said to be paid digitally; this is a staff verification matter.
Nothing stated on a number at birth.

facts.fact: The Department of Home Affairs says it is deploying a biometric verification solution to interface with national population and payroll databases under DPSA Circular 36 of 2025, with verification still underway and a report due 28 February 2026.

ZAF.note: The national population database is named only as a verification target; nothing on the ID system itself.

facts.fact: The Department of Home Affairs says its staff biometric verification solution will interface with national population databases to confirm each employee's identity and that the person is alive.
